messages:
alex_sales: Hey @support — demo with Premier Health right now. We're seeing a spike of 5xxs (mostly 503 throttle) on the POC endpoint; demo customer hitting around ~800 QPS for 20s and the UI starts returning errors. Can someone triage?

marta_partner: adding context — they ran a scripted load for a 10-min demo ramp. They used the hosted key and model pinned to rdx-large-v1. We promised no disruption. Customer is watching.

jess_support: on it. Can you paste the exact curl/requests and any request IDs? Also svc region?

alex_sales: thanks. region=us-west-2. sample request id in payload header: X-Req-Id: 8a7f3c2d. Error from client: 503 Service Temporarily Unavailable (Throttle: capacity exceeded).

sam_oncall: seeing the alert in the infra dashboard: autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. Current provisioned GPUs=4, pending queued requests jumped to 1200 tokens/s. target_capacity estimated 8 nodes but scale-up stuck at 4 for ~40s.

infra_bot: alert: autoscale-lag:scale-loop-duration=42s; queue-length=1150; avg-latency=620ms.

jess_support: can you grab the runtime logs for that req id? run: `curl -H \"X-Req-Id: 8a7f3c2d\" https://internal-logs.redwood/_search?reqid=8a7f3c2d`

sam_oncall: pasted recent runtime tail:

```
2026-03-21T15:12:03Z [worker-2] WARN kvcache: eviction pressure high
2026-03-21T15:12:04Z [router] ERROR backpressure: queue_len=1150, inflight=480
2026-03-21T15:12:05Z [autoscaler] INFO decision: desired=8, current=4, action=start-instances
2026-03-21T15:12:05Z [autoscaler] ERROR launch: rate-limit api call failed (429), retrying
2026-03-21T15:12:07Z [router] ERROR serve: returned 503 (Throttle) to client req=8a7f3c2d
```

alex_sales: so autoscaler failed to call cloud API? what do we do to protect the demo now?

sam_oncall: short-term mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to quantized rdx-medium-v1 on the route (less GPU mem / faster cold starts) 2) temporarily bump reserved burstpool to handle this demo (we can allocate 2 warm burst nodes) 3) throttle customer test ramp to ~300 QPS.

jess_support: I can switch route to fallback variant now — need approval from infra or Eng to allow burstpool manual allocation. @sam_oncall can you toggle?

sam_oncall: I can. Doing two steps: 
- kick manual burstpool allocate: `./ops/allocate-burst --pool demo-premier --nodes 2`
- flip fallback policy in router: `POST /routes/premier-demo {\"fallback_model\":\"rdx-medium-v1\",\"max_qps\":500}`

deploy-bot: job 98431 started: allocate-burst demo-premier (2 nodes)

sam_oncall: burst allocation accepted by cloud (request id a1b2c3). But autoscaler cloud API is throttling because our org is hitting rate limits at provider side (we have a queued retry flood). Working with infra to backoff.

marta_partner: customer is already seeing errors — any ETA to stop 503s?

sam_oncall: ETA ~30-45s after burst nodes register. Meanwhile switching route to fallback model now.

jess_support: switched route to fallback: `rdx-medium-v1` + `max_qps=500`. Please test.

alex_sales: running the same script now — will report in 10s.

alex_sales: update: much better. Errors dropped to <1% after 25s. Latency back down to ~120ms median. Customer relieved. :relieved:

marta_partner: nice. Customer asked if this will affect pricing during POC.

jess_support: fallback model reduces cost per token ~40% for this workload. For the demo period we'll waive overage for Premier Health — I'll note it and route to billing for a temporary credit.

sam_oncall: root cause followup — autoscaler calls were being rate-limited by cloud provider. We need a fix: either exponential backoff + jitter on our side, and add a small pre-warm pool for scheduled demos from Sales. Filed infra ticket: INF-2026 (priority P2).

infra_bot: ticket INF-2026 created: \"provider api rate limit causes autoscale lag during demo spikes\" assigned to @sam_oncall, @jess_support.

alex_sales: action items for us: 1) confirm billing credit (marta + billing) 2) schedule a prewarm for their production POC next week 3) engineering to implement better backoff and a demo prewarm option.

marta_partner: I'll own prewarm scheduling and customer comms.

sam_oncall: I'll follow up on INF-2026 and add a short-term change to retry/backoff logic; will post PR link.

jess_support: closing loop here — reopening if errors reappear. Good catch everyone.

alex_sales: thanks team. Customer wants a short blurb on what happened for their security/comms doc — I'll draft.

sam_oncall: follow-up note (will add to ticket): mitigation checklist: `1) manual-burstpool, 2) fallback-model policy, 3) throttle-test guidance, 4) provider backoff fix, 5) scheduling prewarm`

alex_sales: copying the customer update in case helpful: \"We saw transient 503s because our autoscaler experienced provider-side rate limits while launching extra inference instances; we routed to a lighter-weight model and allocated a short-lived burst pool to eliminate errors. Engineering has a ticket to harden autoscaler retries and we will prewarm for your next demo.\"

jess_support: note made. Closing this thread in 2h if no regressions.
